ns0:section.ns0:heading: Federal Judicial Center

ns0:content.ns0:p: The Federal Judicial Center shall advise and consult with the planning groups and the district courts in connection with their duties under this chapter.

ns0:section.ns0:sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 93–619, title I, § 101, Jan. 3, 1975, 88 Stat. 2084.)
